The name of the Logstore group.

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，查询当前账号下的所有Logstore组。返回结果显示，当前账号下有两个Logstore组，分别是`Logstore_test`和`Logstore_aliyun`。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example of how to query all Logstore groups in the current account. The response shows that the current account has two Logstore groups: `Logstore_test` and `Logstore_aliyun`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-hybrid-monitor-sls-group --keyword Logstore --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --sls-group-name Logstore_test --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms DescribeHybridMonitorSLSGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Keyword Logstore --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SLSGroupName Logstore_test
